summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of QRU Factory. Backend: 30/30 pytest cases pass (auth, RBAC, dashboard/analytics, knowledge records, manufacturing orders + kanban stages, products AI generation, workforce, health colleges, customers, notifications, global search, user management, command AI). Frontend: all key flows work — admin+executive login, dashboard with 4 stats + pipeline + activity, KR create/translate/verify with AI populating consumer_translation/analogy/story/memory_sentence, Research Center runs AI and creates draft KR, Manufacturing Orders Kanban shows 6 columns and MO create+advance works, Product Manufacturing generates markdown via AI and appears in Product Library, Digital Workforce shows 13 employees with detail dialog, Health University shows 7 colleges, Analytics renders 4 recharts, Customers/Notifications/Users work, global search returns grouped results, Command Console AI reply creates linked entity. No console errors during main flows.

minor.issue: When emergent LLM call fails (e.g., transient 'Budget exceeded' from litellm) the endpoint returns bare HTTP 500 with 'Internal Server Error'. Should wrap ai_service.llm_generate calls in try/except and return 502/503 with a user-friendly message so the UI can surface a proper toast. Observed intermittently once during test_translate_kr; passed on retry.

issues: Category field uses native <select> instead of shadcn Select component — visually inconsistent with the rest of the enterprise theme, and produces a React hydration warning ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>'). Consider migrating to the shadcn Select for consistency and to silence the console warning.

action_items: Wrap AI-calling endpoints (translate, product/generate, command, research via command) with try/except around llm_generate to return 502/503 with a friendly message instead of 500 on transient LLM failures.
Replace the native <select> for Category in KnowledgeRecords New-Record dialog with the shadcn Select to fix the hydration warning and match theme.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS middleware is added AFTER include_router. In Starlette this still works but the convention is to add middleware before routes; also allow_origins default '*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec — should set explicit origins when using credentials.
ai_service.py callers: no error handling — any LLM failure surfaces as 500 with unhandled exception.
auth.py: JWT expiry hard-coded to 7 days; consider making configurable via env.
routers/analytics.py: 'knowledge_growth' is synthetic/hard-coded — acceptable for MVP but should be documented or replaced with real time-series aggregation before production.
routers/knowledge.py list_records: no pagination (to_list(500)); fine for now but will not scale.

routers/misc.py users_router.create_user: role sanitized only if not in ROLES — good, but there is no validation preventing creation of another Administrator from an admin session; that may or may not be intentional.
test_credentials: Admin admin@qru.com / qru-admin-2026 ; Executive executive@qru.com / qru-exec-2026 (both work).
